items.html:
Devon Thomas kept wickets for West Indies' Under-19 in the 2008 World Cup in Malaysia. He took to cricket in 2000 and played for West Indies' Under-19s - he also represents the Leeward Islands - against Barbados in the KFC Cup in 2007-08. He made his one-day international debut in 2009, as part of the weakened West Indies team to play Bangladesh after the senior squad boycotted the series over a contracts dispute with the board.
Cricinfo staff August2009
